_comment: Tier-2 for febio::linear_elasticity#4. A <value lc="1"> with no matching <load_controller id="1"> in <LoadData> reads SUCCESS and then fails at initialisation with 'Invalid load curve ID' + 'Model initialization failed', exit 1. init_error() asserts the reader said SUCCESS on the wrong deck — the misleading half of the pitfall — and that the positive control (identical deck plus the <LoadData> block) runs to normal termination without either message. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 keeps the <LoadData> section in the "wrong" slot, so the load-curve id resolves. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'missing_load_controller=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
